lessons.title: Practice Custom Exception Classes
lessons.description: Finish set_age. Subclass Exception to create domain-specific errors. Raise InvalidAgeError when age is negative. The test checks that set_age(21) equals 21; invalid input raises InvalidAgeError.
learning_objectives: This step handles the custom error and shows a reading, using Boom holding stop.

tests.name: test_invalid_age
tests.unittest_code:
def test_invalid_age(self):
    self.assertEqual(set_age(21), 21)
    with self.assertRaises(InvalidAgeError):
        set_age(-1)

source.name: Python official documentation (docs.python.org) — Defining and Naming Exceptions — derive exceptions from Exception (Tutorial)

lessons.title: Practice Unit 15 Checkpoint Exceptions Mastery
lessons.description: Implement read_config(data) that raises KeyError wrapped as ValueError('missing key') when 'host' is absent. The test checks that read_config({'host': 'localhost'}) equals 'localhost'; invalid input raises ValueError.
learning_objectives: This step returns a clear fallback when the name is missing, using lookup holding a.

tests.name: test_read_config
tests.unittest_code:
def test_read_config(self):
    self.assertEqual(read_config({'host': 'localhost'}), 'localhost')
    with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
        read_config({})

source.name: Python official documentation (docs.python.org) — Raising Exceptions — raise ValueError(...) (Tutorial)
